goal: Verify that a user can successfully create a new Site Host account and navigate to the settings menu to adjust application configuration options.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged in and viewing the main dashboard, click the settings icon (gear symbol) located in the left sidebar to open the settings menu.
In the settings menu, click the 'settings2' button to apply the secondary configuration view.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the registration page to the main dashboard after clicking 'Sign up'.
The settings menu is visible and accessible after clicking the gear icon in the sidebar.
The application state updates to reflect the 'settings2' configuration (e.g., specific UI elements or data views change as expected).
No error messages are displayed during the account creation or navigation process.
The user remains logged in and retains access to the dashboard after the settings interaction.
